from pathlib import Path

 im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(b)).convert('RGBA'); a=im.getchannel('A'); hist=a.histogram(); n=im.width*im.height; nz=n-hist[0]; ge128=sum(hist[128:]); ge240=sum(hist[240:]);
 print('BYTES',label,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes',len(b),'size',im.size,'alpha_nonzero',nz/n,'alpha_ge128',ge128/n,'alpha_ge240',ge240/n)

 p=root/rel
 if p.exists(): desc_bytes('FILE:'+rel,p.read_bytes())

for route in ['/augen_blink/blink_000.png','/augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png']:
 with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8788'+route,timeout=10) as r:
  b=r.read(); print('HTTP_STATUS',route,r.status,r.headers.get('Content-Type'),r.headers.get('Content-Length')); desc_bytes('HTTP:'+route,b)
